label: Dance · Shuffle
desc: Running man, T-step, a spin on the heels, quick kicks, a stomp into a wide stance.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, graceful and dynamic motion, highly detailed

beats.prompt: a shuffle dancer in loose streetwear starts running in place using rapid running-man footwork
they slide their feet laterally in a fast T-step pattern, pivoting heels and toes to the rhythm
they execute a fast 360-degree spin on their heels while keeping their legs shifting constantly
they perform a series of fast forward kicks, lightly tapping their soles against the ground
they stomp hard on the floor to hit the final beat, landing in a wide low stance with arms open
